notes.title: August 26 Patch
notes.notes:
Fix for Idle mode getting stuck after a long period of time.
 Fixed Blessing of the Sloth should now trigger mushroom growth as stated in the tooltip. (Was accidently checking for the final blessing being active instead of the Sloth blessing)

notes.title: August 22 Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I've decided to do a tiny update that adds a "Perfection" reward if you max all upgrades for the field. I decided not to make it a Steam achievement for now since I don't want to force people to idle the game so much just for 1 final achievement. It's just a cute little statue you'll get if you decide to go for it.

Once you achieve perfection, there's one more upgrade that you can get that is not meant to be maxed out - it's just for fun. Perhaps it's possible to max it out if you idle the game for many days (I'm not really sure). It's really not all that interesting and I personally wouldn't bother with it but maybe there are some insane people out there who are into this sort of thing...I don't know...let's find out! For now, it's just one upgrade that decreases the spawn timer by 1% per level up to level 99 which would be a 99% decrease in the delay between grass spawns. So basically you just have endless grass uptime.

I wanted to add an alternative ending where you save the world but for now I'll just keep it as is because the code for the ending sequence and scene is a mess. Maybe I'll do it in the future when I'm more motivated at some point.

Also, I did the work for localization - putting all the text strings into a spreadsheet. I just need to find people to localize things and theoretically it should be pretty easy to put into the game. But I think there will be some places where the text gets cut off if the new string is too big. Well, eventually the game will be localized it's just not something that I'd call fun to do so I've been going pretty slow with it.

Anyways, during development I got a couple interesting ideas for new games I've been trying to prototype. I'm not sure what I'm going to do next. I might just end up doing a sequel since the code is fresh in my head and I have some ideas for how the game could work differently or better. But starting from the beginning is somewhat daunting because I can feel the amount of work ahead.

I will keep moving forward maybe some days a bit slower than others and will try to keep you posted as much as I can. My doctor says I need to get more sun because I'm a vampire so maybe I'll do some of that before it starts getting too cold.

That's all for now. Hope you all had some fun playing the game. See ya in the next update and stay safe and healthy everyone! I love you all.

notes.title: August 10 Patch
notes.notes:
Added a couple of prestige upgrades to improve cash and essence gain in the late game.

Added ball of yarn! Play with your kittens with the yarn! You can click the ball of yarn 5 times to get a buff that doubles base grass value and essence gain for a couple minutes.  

Added hay. Hay accumulates (up to 3) on the right side of the grass field. You can click the hay to feed your animals and gain a buff that also doubles base grass value and essence gain for 1 minute.  

The game has a proper icon now instead of showing up as a generic windows exe icon in the taskbar.  



Hopefully the game isn't too easy now... I might tweak the numbers in the future, we'll see how it goes.

notes.title: Aug 9 Patch
notes.notes:
Grass should grow back evenly now instead of just growing back the last cut grass. (Should fix the patchiness that could happen sometimes).
 Fix some bugs that could happen when switching save slots.

notes.title: August 8 Patch
notes.notes:
Some changes and upgrades to alter the way Sneaky Cat works and smooth out the difficulty curve.


 Sneaky Cat will spawn more often but the duration of the buff reduced from 40s to 30s and it will only increase Essence chance by 4x instead of 10x.
 Added Cat Food prestige upgrade that will double the chance of spawning a sneaky cat when you fill the cat bowl by clicking on it (lasts 60 seconds).
 Added Fat Cat prestige upgrade that will make the Sneaky Cat larger and buff the Essence chance to 8x from 4x.


Hopefully this makes the sneaky cat more common to encourage more activity and also makes the buff less extreme and "all or nothing". Lots of people forgot about sneaky cat or never saw it and it is making them take much longer to finish the game compared to people who find the sneaky cat.

notes.title: Aug 7 Patch
notes.notes:
You can move and resize the Blessing UI now.
 When resizing the shop windows the buy buttons should stay visible until there's no more space. It's not perfect but it should be better.
 Blessing of Space and Time changed from 1.5x to 1.35x speed upgrade. Also removed the Essence Gain multiplier from it and reduced the base cash value gain from 2x to 1.5x. (Let's be real it was overpowered)


Also did some work on localization but it's not available in the game yet. Not sure if I'll put it in as it seems to be a huge pain to maintain all the translations. If I leave things in English I can quickly add and change things without having to update 5 or 6 different languages. I'll probably wait until later when I know things won't be changing.

notes.title: August 3 Patch
notes.notes:
Added Crop Connoisser upgrade to double the chance of finding golden crops.
 Space Time Blessing no longer reduces other active blessing durations.
 Improved Triple Regrowth so that the staggered regrowths occur twice as quickly.
 Prestige Upgrade tooltips now show current essence count directly in the tooltip.
 Tweaked some of the blessing durations a bit.


Some of these upgrades should make you a bit more powerful in the late game to reduce the grind a bit. I might add add a couple more powerful prestige upgrades to help as well.

notes.title: Aug 2 Patch

 Fix for crash on start if your windows username has special chars
 Fix for indestructable tree bug
 Fix tooltip for tier 1 ponderers

notes.title: Game of Grass Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I wanted to give a little update about the game. I'll just let this be my outlet because I don't have anyone else I can really talk to about my game.



First of all, I wanted to thank all the YouTubers that covered the game. I am so accustomed to a complete lack of attention that it is quite shocking to have the opposite suddenly happen. I feel a lot of responsibility and pressure to make the game great because it seems to be somewhat popular.



So I've been working hard on the game for quite a while and I may be biased but the game is pretty amazing now. The dopamine levels released are second to none. I did a lot of experimentation adding things to the game. Some things worked some things didn't. I've added some more things to cut besides just grass. I didn't want to stray too much from the main pillar of the game - cutting grass; particularly making that feel very satisfying. The new things add to that feeling quite a bit and I think you all are going to love it.



I also added a prestige system to the game. Initially it was not part of the plan but I think it's become expected from this genre now. It's been a lot of work but I think it's turned out well. Some upgrades and special abilities have been moved into the prestige system and I think they make more sense to be there.



I basically just need to polish a couple things and then I'm going to do a lot of number-tweaking to try to make things balanced so I hope to announce a release date soon. The game will hopefully release in 3 - 4 weeks!



Things have taken a bit longer than I expected because I'm not using an engine. The downside of not using an engine is things generally take a bit longer to prototype and some players are still reporting issues running the game. I hope to fix most of them in the next demo update - probably within a week or so. I'm waiting on a device that will let me digitally sign the .exe file so that antivirus issue will go away (hopefully).

The upside of not using an engine is the game runs like an absolute champ. I should probably test it out on a lesser computer but on my computer I get 144 FPS with some dips to 100 when a lot of crazy stuff happens. I grew up on the NES and that had some limitation where it could only draw 8 sprites horizontally at the same time. So this is pretty incredible that I'm drawing tens of thousands of sprites and the game is running so well. The grass field alone is 7000 sprites when maxed out. I can't wait for people to see the full version. It is totally insane.



Anyways, I'll keep you posted on the release date! Stay tuned for more news!

notes.title: Demo Update June 4
notes.notes:
Updated the demo to fix some issues and other misc. gameplay things.


 Updated Titlescreen image.
 Bigger font for 4k monitors.
 Can move and resize the upgrade windows.
 Collectors won't target the same crops anymore.
 Walking path and grass chutes available in the demo.
 Improved reward for beating the demo.
 Probably more stuff I'm forgetting.


I'm working on adding a prestige system but it's taking longer than I anticipated. It's not available in the demo but maybe soon.
Since I'm not using an engine some things take longer than they would otherwise. Actually, believe it or not, this game wouldn't run very well if I did use an engine like Unity or Godot. The downside is certain things like making UI are very painful for me =).

Also, the demo could use more reviews so please leave one if you like the game. Thank you!
